head_commit.message:
perf(engine): reuse RHS scans across capped seed blocks (#6477)

* perf(engine): reuse capped RHS scans without armed budgets

Reuse a reached non-bind pattern only for the same requested scan order. Borrow existing join kernels without changing per-block planner or smaller-side hash build decisions. Keep original scan lifetime when a query budget is armed.

Add actual-query three-block scan witnesses and focused cache, multiset, repeated-variable and budget checks. Scan-count evidence only; latency and retained-memory assessment remain pending.

Co-Authored-By: GPT-6 Astra <noreply@openai.com>

* fix(engine): release replaced capped RHS and pin query paths

Drop a stale RHS slot before running its replacement scan. Add test-only observations and public-query multiset checks for changing scan order, mixed bind/merge/hash paths, disconnected cross products, named views, overlays and the existing EXISTS fallback.

Co-Authored-By: GPT-6 Astra <noreply@openai.com>

* fix(engine): bound retained capped RHS storage

Limit query-local RHS scan storage to a private 4 MiB allowance using actual buffer and variable-text capacities. Keep non-fitting relations ephemeral, reject unproved spilled-row storage, and refund stale ownership before replacement scans. Add capacity, many-relation and armed-budget controls. Declare the intentional always-compiled engine change without asserting wasm byte neutrality or changing the size ratchet.

Co-Authored-By: GPT-6 Astra <noreply@openai.com>
